table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.purprice,   
	Item.PackUnits,   
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
	Packing=(SELECT P.Name FROM ItemPacking P WHERE P.PackCode = Item.PackCode),
	Manufacturer.name,
	classname=itemclass.name,
	Category=itemcategory.name,  
	UnitPrice = Case :ai_pricetype 
		WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice /  CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) /  CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
	END ,
	PackQty = Round(isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) /  CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	StockValue = isnull(Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) *
	Case :ai_pricetype 
		WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
	END

FROM 
	Manufacturer,   
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode=itemclass.iccode),
	ItemCategory
WHERE 
	( Item.ICCode IN (:classcode ) ) and
	( itemclass.iccode = Item.iccode ) and
	( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
	( Item.active=1) and
	( Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)

GROUP BY 
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active, 
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.PackUnits, 
	Itemclass.name,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name ,
	Manufacturer.name,
	Item.PackCode
table.sort: classname A, category A, item_name A
